QI 105: قيادة تحسين الجودة

English

This course develops the leadership competencies essential for driving quality improvement in healthcare organizations. You will learn how to lead improvement projects through all phases, build effective teams, overcome resistance, and create sustainable change. The course is specifically designed for Saudi Arabian healthcare leaders, addressing cultural considerations, organizational structures in MOH and private facilities, and alignment with Vision 2030 leadership expectations. Key Learning Areas: - Leading improvement projects through all phases - Applying IHI's Framework for Spread - Understanding change psychology and human dynamics - Building and leading interprofessional teams - Engaging leadership at all levels - Creating cultures of continuous improvement - Adapting leadership approaches for Saudi healthcare context

العربية

تطور هذه الدورة الكفاءات القيادية الأساسية لقيادة تحسين الجودة في المنظمات الصحية. ستتعلم كيفية قيادة مشاريع التحسين عبر جميع المراحل، وبناء فرق فعالة، والتغلب على المقاومة، وخلق تغيير مستدام. صُممت الدورة خصيصاً لقادة الرعاية الصحية السعوديين، مع معالجة الاعتبارات الثقافية والهياكل التنظيمية في مرافق وزارة الصحة والمرافق الخاصة، والمحاذاة مع توقعات القيادة لرؤية 2030. مناطق التعلم الرئيسية: - قيادة مشاريع التحسين عبر جميع المراحل - تطبيق إطار عمل IHI للنشر - فهم سيكولوجية التغيير والديناميكيات البشرية - بناء وقيادة الفرق متعددة التخصصات - إشراك القيادة على جميع المستويات - خلق ثقافات التحسين المستمر - تكييف مقاربات القيادة للسياق الصحي السعودي

English Learning Outcomes

After completing this course, you will be able to: - Lead improvement projects through all four phases from initiation to sustainability - Apply IHI's Framework for Spread to implement changes organization-wide - Assess organizational readiness and individual change tolerance - Address common sources of resistance to improvement initiatives - Build effective interprofessional improvement teams - Navigate organizational dynamics and power structures - Engage executive and physician leaders in improvement work - Create sustainable improvement cultures - Adapt leadership approaches for Saudi healthcare organizations - Align improvement leadership with CBAHI governance requirements

مخرجات التعلم بالعربية

بنهاية هذه الدورة، ستكون قادراً على: - قيادة مشاريع التحسين عبر جميع المراحل من البدء إلى الاستدامة - تطبيق إطار عمل IHI للنشر لتنفيذ التغييرات على مستوى المؤسسة - تقييم الجاهزية التنظيمية والتسامح الفردي للتغيير - معالجة المصادر الشائعة لمقاومة مبادرات التحسين - بناء فرق تحسين فعالة متعددة التخصصات - التنقل في الديناميكيات التنظيمية والهياكل السلطوية - إشراك القادة التنفيذيين والأطباء في عمل التحسين - خلق ثقافات تحسين مستدامة - تكييف مقاربات القيادة للمنظمات الصحية السعودية - محاذاة قيادة التحسين مع متطلبات حوكمة CBAHI

Case Study: Physician-Led Improvement Initiative | دراسة الحالة: مبادرة تحسين يقودها الطبيب

Hospital: King Abdulaziz Medical City, Riyadh Improvement Focus: Reducing unnecessary lab testing Challenge: High volume of routine lab tests ordered without clear indication, driving up costs and creating patient discomfort. Leadership Approach:
|
-|
--|
| Key Success Factors: 1. Physician-to-physician communication was more effective than administrative mandates 2. Evidence-based guidelines respected clinical autonomy while reducing variation 3. Order set integration made the new approach the path of least resistance 4. Regular feedback on test utilization maintained engagement

Case Study: Creating a Culture of Safety | دراسة الحالة: خلق ثقافة السلامة

Organization: PHC Cluster, Eastern Province Focus: Building safety culture across 15 primary health centers Leadership Journey: |
|
-|
|
--|
PhaseActionLeadership Strategy
InitiationIdentified cardiologist championEngaged respected physician early
PlanningDeveloped evidence-based guidelinesProvided data support, protected time
TestingPilot in Cardiology outpatient clinicChampioned peer-to-peer education
ImplementationPhased rollout across departmentsMaintained visibility, addressed resistance
SustainabilityIntegrated into order setsOngoing monitoring by physician champion
YearFocusActivitiesOutcomes
Year 1AwarenessSafety culture survey, leadership trainingBaseline assessment, awareness raised
Year 2FoundationEvent reporting system, RCA training50% increase in reporting, 5 RCA completed
Year 3IntegrationSafety huddles, unit-based improvementDaily huddles in all 15 centers
Year 4SustainabilityRecognition program, succession planningSustained reporting, staff promotion pathway
Leadership Lessons: - Executive commitment visible in resource allocation - Small wins built momentum and confidence - Staff recognized publicly for safety contributions - Safety metrics integrated into performance evaluation

Exercise 1: Stakeholder Mapping

Create a stakeholder map for your improvement project: ``` STAKEHOLDER ANALYSIS MATRIX =============================
|
-|
--|
--|
-|
-|
StakeholderInfluenceImpactCurrent StanceStrategy
Hospital DirectorHighHighSupportiveKeep engaged
Medical DirectorHighHighNeutralBrief regularly
Chief NurseHighHighSupportiveInvolve in steering
Head of MedicineMediumHighResistantAddress concerns
ICU Nurse ManagerMediumMediumNeutralTrain and support
Pharmacy DirectorMediumMediumSupportiveLeverage support
Frontline nursesLowMediumVariedCommunicate, train
PatientsLowMediumSurvey feedback
INFLUENCE: High/Medium/Low CURRENT STANCE: Supportive/Neutral/Resistant ```

Exercise 2: Resistance Response Planning

For each resistance source, develop a response: ``` RESISTANCE RESPONSE PLANNER ============================= RESISTANCE SOURCE: "I don't have time for this" Possible Responses: 1. Acknowledge time pressure 2. Show how it will save time in the long run 3. Integrate into existing workflow 4. Provide protected time for training 5. Demonstrate quick wins MY CHOSEN RESPONSE: _____________________________ WHY: ____________________________________________ EVIDENCE THAT IT WORKS: __________________________ NEXT STEPS: ______________________________________ ```

Exercise 3: Team Composition Assessment

Evaluate your improvement team: ``` TEAM ASSESSMENT CHECKLIST =========================== COMPOSITION: [ ] Executive Sponsor identified [ ] Physician Champion identified [ ] Nursing Champion identified [ ] Quality Lead assigned [ ] Operations representation included [ ] Frontline staff included [ ] Patient/family perspective considered COMPETENCIES: [ ] Quality improvement methodology knowledge [ ] Data analysis capability [ ] Clinical expertise represented [ ] Process knowledge available [ ] Communication skills [ ] Change management experience GAPS IDENTIFIED: ______________________________ ACTIONS TO ADDRESS GAPS: _________________________ ```
1. Think about a change initiative that failed due to human factors. What could you have done differently? 2. What is the most common source of resistance you face in your organization? How can you address it? 3. Who are the opinion leaders in your organization who could help or hinder your improvement work? 4. How does the hierarchical culture in Saudi healthcare affect your approach to improvement leadership? 5. What would it take to move your organization from "improvement project" to "improvement culture"?

English Action Checklist

Complete these actions within 30 days:
Identify and engage your executive sponsor
Recruit physician and nursing champions
Form your multidisciplinary improvement team
Conduct a stakeholder analysis for your project
Assess organizational readiness for improvement
Develop communication plan for your team
Establish regular team meeting schedule
Create ground rules for effective team meetings
Identify potential resistance and develop response strategies
Present improvement project to quality governance committee
